hints.title: Two Case Circular Decomposition
hints.text: The maximum circular subarray either lies entirely within the array without wrapping, or wraps around both ends by excluding a minimum subarray from the middle.

hints.title: Dual Extremum Kadane Invariant
hints.text: Running Kadane algorithm once for maximum subarray sum and once for minimum subarray sum provides both the non-wrapping maximum and total minus minimum wrapping candidates.

hints.title: Dual Extremum Kadane Evaluation Procedure
hints.text: Track total sum, current and global maximum subarray sum, and current and global minimum subarray sum in a single pass. If the global maximum is negative, all numbers are negative, so return that global maximum. Otherwise, return the maximum between global maximum and total minus global minimum.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def maxSubarraySumCircular(self, nums: List[int]) -> int:
        total = 0
        cur_max, max_sum = 0, nums[0]
        cur_min, min_sum = 0, nums[0]
        for x in nums:
            cur_max = max(x, cur_max + x)
            max_sum = max(max_sum, cur_max)
            cur_min = min(x, cur_min + x)
            min_sum = min(min_sum, cur_min)
            total += x
        return max_sum if max_sum < 0 else max(max_sum, total - min_sum)
```

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Doubling the array and testing all subarray windows of size at most N takes quadratic O(N^2) time without monotonic structures.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Simultaneously tracking max and min subarray sums with Kadane algorithm solves the problem in O(N) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate must identify the all-negative corner case where total - minSubarray results in an empty subarray with sum 0.
